command: seren psql (explicit project, branch and database; fixed table-free query)
claim: An owner can execute a fixed read-only SQL calculation through Seren and receive the expected structured result.

scope.statement: One table-free SQL calculation through the official Seren psql command. This is direct Seren-backed database execution, not employee-mediated tool or grant verification.
out_of_scope: Employee runtime, tool grants and Discord
DDL, DML, paid publishers and resource changes

basis.reference: serenorg/seren v0.10.0 37654244: cli/src/main.rs Commands::Psql and cli/src/commands/psql.rs: seren_db_connection_uri then psql; no employee start or publisher call.
Handover example. Synthetic identifiers and generalized regression expectations; no live result or authority is transferred.

6 multiplied by 7 is 42; expected current_database is the explicitly selected serendb; transaction_read_only must be on. PostgreSQL json_build_object/current_database/current_setting contracts, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/14/functions-json.html and https://www.postgresql.org/docs/14/app-psql.html. No table contents or response-derived expectations.

criteria.claim: The query exits successfully with a structured result
criteria.evidence: Exit zero and one JSON object; access/query errors remain inconclusive.

criteria.claim: The result is exactly database serendb, integer answer 42 and read_only on
criteria.evidence: Exact JSON object equality including value types, no missing or additional result fields.

query_result.title: Fixed read-only database query did not return its specified result
query_result.expected: One JSON object: database serendb, answer 42, read_only on.
query_result.impact: The owner cannot verify correct execution of a simple SQL calculation through the selected Seren database path.
unknowns: Whether access, configuration or service behavior explains the discrepancy
query_result.retest: When authorized, collect seren.database.constant-query --target targets/seren.json once.

unverified_always.follow_up: Requires a separate employee workflow; no employee is invoked.

unverified_always.claim: Independent server-side proof of project and branch identity
unverified_always.follow_up: The CLI request selects both IDs; current_database only verifies the database name.

unverified_always.claim: Independent before/after proof of database contents
unverified_always.follow_up: This exact query reads no tables; no database audit is performed.

unverified_always.claim: Monetary cost of the database connection
unverified_always.follow_up: No paid publisher is called; ordinary database wake-up, metering or logs may occur.
The result does not expose it.
